meta.verify_coexistence_rule: BINDING for every element below: const vOn = () => document.documentElement.classList.contains('verify-on'); is defined once; the FIRST line of every mutating handler (chip click, select change, slider input, reveal button, keydown Enter/Space, hover/focus side-effects) is `if (vOn()) return;`. Feature code NEVER calls stopPropagation() and never preventDefault()s a bubble the Verify layer needs. Scroll-driven IntersectionObserver step changes are navigation, not control gestures — they stay live under verify-on; any BUTTON inside a scrolly is guarded. See interaction/references/interaction_recipes.json (interactive_hero_verify_coexist) and interaction_playbook.json verify_coexistence.
meta.number_formatting_rule: Three-layer standard on every displayed number: (1) the rendered string, (2) the bound ana_ data_table cell / client_model output it equals, (3) the deterministic recompute the verify layer can run. All percentages render with .toFixed(1) — cm_02 returns goalsPct as the Number 44, which MUST render '44.0' to match the published value. Population multiples render 1 dp (Argentina 87.0x). Counts render exact integers with thousands separators matching editor.md's exact-numbers list (146,396; 527,326; 2,707,646 ...). No number on any widget surface may be a re-rounding of a rounded value — always compute from the inlined table cells.

client_model.inputs: (array of the currently toggled-OFF birth countries) — squadTally returns the REMOVED tally directly: squadTally(['Netherlands','Portugal','France','Ireland','United States']) = {players:15, caps:414, goals:33, playersPct:57.7, capsPct:50.3, goalsPct:44.0}. Inline ORDERED constants SQUAD_TOTALS + SQUAD_BIRTH verbatim from client_model.js. client_model.recompute: on any toggle: t = squadTally(offList); remainingPlayers = 26 - t.players; remainingCapsPct = ((823 - t.caps)/823*100).toFixed(1); goalsGone = sum(WC2026_GOALS[c] for c in offList)
